answer: The terrace counter is kept in forge and lagoon exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2314 identities would post 4487 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
